title: Three Winters and One Short Meter
subtitle: 污染治理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 污染治理（人与自然·环境保护·污染与治理）
meta: 主题语境：污染治理（人与自然·环境保护·污染与治理）　|　核心词汇：gas　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gas 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the inspector ① measured the gas that no neighbour in the street would have described, and he said the measuring was the whole of the winter. The ② gas, meaning the fumes themselves and not the smoke, ran three winters and stayed undescribed in the book; gas, he said, is the only thing in a street that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of gas in that street had the same short meter beside it, and the ④ gas at the far pipe, meaning the supply they kept for the children's school and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Gas, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the inspector said the describing is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the gas was the whole of the matter, meaning the fuel and not the fumes. The ⑥ gas, meaning the fuel and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; gas, he said, is either something you measure or the only word that means both a fume and a fuel. He said the fuel is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ gas had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short meter. The ⑧ gas of the whole thing, the inspector wrote in November, was one street and three winters of describing; gas, he said, is either the supply at the far pipe or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ gas I remember is the gas described in the plan, which closed in 1979 and is still described as the quietest in the street. ⑩ Gas, my mother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being described; all gas, she said, is a fuel that has agreed to look like a fume. She said the fuel was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 气体；废气（指街上每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 气体；废气（指那些气体本身，与烟尘相对）
C. 固定搭配：measure the gas 测量废气
D. n. 燃气（指留给孩子们学校用的那一路供应）
E. n. 气体（抽象总称，指一条街的废气之事）
F. n. 气体（指治理方案里写到、被测量过的那些）
G. n. 燃气；燃料（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 燃气（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: measured the gas that no neighbour in the street would have described
The gas, meaning the fumes themselves and not the smoke
Every kind of gas in that street
the gas at the far pipe
the gas was the whole of the matter
the gas had become a line in a plan
The gas of the whole thing

answers.why: measure the gas 意为“测量废气”，1972 年那位检查员测量了街上没有一位邻居肯描述的气体。
gas 意为“气体、废气”，指那些气体本身而不是烟尘，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被描述。
gas 意为“气体、废气”，指街上每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一只矮矮的计量表。
gas 意为“燃气”，指最远那根管子里留给孩子们学校用的那一路供应，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
gas 意为“燃气、燃料”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这些燃气就是那件事的全部。
gas 意为“燃气”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那些废气，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
gas 意为“气体”，指治理方案里写到、被测量过的那些，到 1977 年这些成了方案里的一行。
gas 意为“气体”，检查员十一月写道，整件事的废气之事是一条街和三个冬天的描述。
gas 意为“气体”，我记得的是方案里描述过的那些，1979 年治理完了，至今仍被说成街上最安静的一批。
gas 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，气体是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
